question: Has gap G004 already been addressed: Construct validity of time-sensitive legal QA evaluation is unexamined: the only version-aware statutory benchmark is fully LLM-generated (697 generated pairs, 312 expert-accepted) with LLM-judged answers, so it is unknown whether measured improvements reflect real retrieval behaviour on amended law or artifacts of the generator and judge.?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
